Thank you to every veteran, and to the families who kept the home running while you served. 🇺🇸

My House Guardian is a house care service for Fairfield County. You get one person who knows your house: they handle the small jobs, schedule the outside pros, and keep track of what was done so you don't have to. Your house, our responsibility.

Veterans get a discount on every package, year-round.
